title: Turn out in full force!
summary:
Turn out in full force!



● A great improvement in chances for successfully reconnecting
● Outdated Gamerules removed: You cannot recruit a certain piece when you have a Rank 3 piece of it already.
● Hoodwink - Acorn Shot: Reworked
● Hunter - Aimed Shot: Reworked.
● Warlock - Soul Leech: (4) strengthened and (6) reworked.
● New Tier 3 Item: Drum of Endurance
● Temporarily removed item: Glimmer Cape, Dragon Lance, Cloak of Tyrants
● Stolen Vault: Randomly gets 10~15 gold instead of 10~20
● Talent4A - Radiance: IO extra chance initiates from +800% instead of +1000%, and still decreases processively by 200% per IO recruited.
● Season Award Preview
● Fix bugs

Click the title link to check the full update details!
